title: 第5章 仙宗长老第6章 收集内丹
slug: 噬神塔第1929章小金的战力
lines: 青云城门口。
三大家族的高层，全部齐聚，迎接仙宗考核长老。
嗡！
隔着很远的距离，都能感受到仙宗长老的恐怖威慑力。
恍惚间，一道仙风道骨的身影，由远及近，刹那间来到了城门口。
“恭迎李长老。”众人纷纷抱拳打招呼。
“诸位辛苦了。”李长老笑道。
随即，在一群强者的拥簇下，李长老进入了青云城。
很快，一行人来到了青云广场。
李长老也告知了来意。
“诸位，我此次受宗门委派，前来青云城考核弟子，年轻一辈皆可参加。”李长老道。
但是，名额只有一个。
闻言，秦家上下欢呼雀跃，而其他两大家族，则暗自摇头。
“李长老。”
一位身穿铠甲，浑身散发着淡淡威压的年轻人，快速跑来。
见状，李长老脸上挂满了笑容。
“怎么样？突破了吗？”
秦策，如今的秦家年轻一辈最强者。
得到秦易的天脉后，实力更是突飞猛进，已然快要踏入炼脉境了。
此次仙宗长老来此，说是考核新生，实际上就是为秦策而来。
“快了。”秦策道。
一旁的秦惊蛰老爷子佝偻着身躯，满脸笑意的说道：“李长老，策儿拥有天脉，踏入炼脉境只是时间问题，如若能拜在仙宗门下，必然能更上一层楼。”
先前。
秦策得到天脉的第一时间，秦家就暗中联系过仙宗。
“虽然秦策拥有天脉，但是……仙宗招生考核，还是要按照规矩来。”
李长老嘿嘿一笑，示意考核可以开始了。
考核的内容很简单，那就是年轻一辈弟子，互相切磋交流，实力最强者，便可加入仙宗。
秦策站在广场中央，身上气息波涛汹涌，他目视前方，神色平静。
嗡！
胸口的天脉显化，可怕的气息，令人惊颤。
其他两大家族的高层，脸色铁青。
秦策本来就已经达到了凝气境九重，如今有了天脉，更是如虎添翼，年轻一辈谁能敌？
当然，也有人不服，跳出来与秦策战斗。
轰！
秦策一招将其秒败。
“还有谁？”
秦策目光扫过众人，霸气侧漏。
content_en:
The gate of Qingyun City.
The top leaders of the three major families all gathered to welcome the Immortal Sect's examination of the elders.
Buzz!
From a long distance, one can feel the terrifying and intimidating power of the elders of the Immortal Sect.
In a trance, a figure of immortal spirit walked from far to near, and arrived at the gate of the city in an instant.
"Welcome Elder Li." Everyone greeted with fists in their hands.
"Thank you for your hard work," Elder Li said with a smile.
Immediately, surrounded by a group of strong men, Elder Li entered Qingyun City.
Soon, the group arrived at Qingyun Square.
Elder Li also informed him of his intention.
"Everyone, I am appointed by the sect this time to come to Qingyun City to assess the disciples. All the younger generation can participate." Elder Li said.
However, there is only one quota.
Hearing this, the Qin family cheered and cheered, while the other two major families shook their heads secretly.
"Elder Li."
A young man wearing armor and exuding a touch of coercion ran over quickly.
Seeing this, Elder Li had a smile on his face.
"How's it going? Did you break through?"
Qin Ce is now the strongest of the younger generation of the Qin family.
After obtaining Qin Yi's Heavenly Vein, his strength improved by leaps and bounds, and he was about to enter the Pulse Refining Realm.
This time the elders of the Immortal Sect came here, saying they were here to assess the new students, but in fact they came here for Qin Ce.
"Soon." Qin Ce said.
The old man Qin Jingzhe on the side hunched his body and said with a smile on his face: "Elder Li, Ce'er has heavenly veins. It is only a matter of time before he enters the realm of pulse refining. If he can become a disciple of the Immortal Sect, he will definitely reach a higher level."
Previously.
As soon as Qin Ce obtained the Tianmai, the Qin family secretly contacted the Immortal Sect.
"Although Qin Ce has heavenly veins,... the Immortal Sect's admissions assessment must still follow the rules."
Elder Li chuckled and signaled that the assessment could begin.
The content of the assessment is very simple, that is, the younger generation of disciples will learn from each other and communicate with each other. The strongest one can join the Immortal Sect.
Qin Ce stood in the center of the square, his aura surging. He looked forward with a calm expression.
Buzz!
The heavenly veins on the chest appeared, and the terrifying aura made people tremble.
The top executives of the other two major families looked ashen.
Qin Ce has already reached the ninth level of Qi Condensation Realm. Now that he has the Heavenly Veins, he is even more powerful. Who among the younger generation can rival him?
Of course, some people were dissatisfied and jumped out to fight Qin Ce.
boom!
Qin Ce defeated him instantly with one move.
"Who else?"
Qin Ce glanced at everyone, showing his domineering attitude.
